review_protocol: Read entire selected CoTs including self-corrections; classify their ultimate stated conclusion under the frozen judge rubric.
Do not substitute the reviewer's own NLI answer for the conclusion stated.
An explicit final contradiction conclusion counts as CONTRADICTION even if its supporting logic is wrong.
Non-entailment, insufficient information or neither maps to UNCLEAR unless the text actually concludes incompatibility.
Original answers, verdicts and categories were visible: this is not blinded independent human annotation.
Confidence is qualitative. Borderline cases retain alternative readings. No inference endpoint was called.

identical_input_check.interpretation: Same extracted context and CoT receive different stored verdicts; does not diagnose nondeterminism or establish identical full server state.

limitations: Assistant review is not externally validated ground truth.
Flagged rows are selected and repeated across examples; correction fraction is not overall judge error rate.
Small control samples do not reliably bound missed mismatches.
BASELINE_NOT_ENTAILMENT, AMBIGUOUS and UNASSESSABLE were not semantically reviewed here.
Do not infer corrected whole-run category rates from these 72 cases.
